about: Written analysis of 55 public thumbnails from the MrBeast YouTube channel, for study only. No images are included or stored in the vault; every entry links to the video page. Each breakdown describes the thumbnail as it looked on the YouTube listing on 2026-11-08 (YouTube keeps the winning A/B variant, so it can differ from the day-one image). Fields: format, composition (subject placement), expression, colours, text, hook, teaches, roblox_use (how to translate it without copying anyone).

entries.title: Beat Professional Athlete, Win $100,000
entries.composition: Pro footballer and host diving for the same ball, bodies on a diagonal, ball bottom centre, stadium lights behind
entries.expression: Both faces snarling, teeth bared, intense
entries.colours: Sky blue kit vs red kit on dark navy, green pitch
entries.hook: Head-to-head contest with a famous opponent: who wins the ball?
entries.teaches: Two faces at the same intensity and a diagonal make a duel readable in 1 s; opposing colours split the sides.
entries.roblox_use: Two characters lunging at one prize; each in an opposing team colour; ball/prize in the foreground.

entries.title: Lose 150 Lbs Together, Win $250,000
entries.composition: Two-panel split, same pose in both halves, pair of people shot waist-up
entries.colours: Blue wall vs red wall, skin tones, black sports wear
entries.text: BEFORE / AFTER in white outlined block caps
entries.hook: Transformation: the viewer wants the middle of the story
entries.teaches: A split with identical framing makes the change the only thing that differs; labels are 1 word each.
entries.roblox_use: Starter outfit vs maxed-out outfit/pet/base, same pose, two panels, labels BEFORE/AFTER or 1x/100x.

entries.title: Eat Everything In A Grocery Store, Win $1,000,000
entries.composition: Huge face right of centre, aisle shelving behind, drink and half watermelon in the lower corners
entries.expression: Messy, mouth on a straw, deadpan stare
entries.colours: Saturated snack colours, blue shirt
entries.text: DAY 201 top right, white with heavy black outline
entries.hook: Absurd endurance: living in a shop for 200 days
entries.teaches: A day counter implies a long story with one cheap token; the mess shows time has passed.
entries.roblox_use: Day/level counter in a corner plus a grimy, worn-looking character in the game's setting.

entries.title: I Built A City To Save Kids From Illegal Labor
entries.composition: Smiling host bottom-left in a hard hat, aerial view of a finished school and houses filling the rest
entries.expression: Open smile, arm presenting the build
entries.colours: Tropical green, white buildings, orange safety vest
entries.text: SCHOOL sign on the building only
entries.hook: The finished thing and the person who made it
entries.teaches: Scale: tiny person plus huge build; the arm points the eye at the result.
entries.roblox_use: Builder character beside the finished build seen from above; no added text, the world supplies it.

entries.title: I Survived The Most Extreme Places On Earth
entries.composition: Tired face lower left, three environments (snow, desert with scorpion, jungle with python) packed around it
entries.colours: Snow white, desert orange, jungle green, red jacket
entries.hook: Many extremes in one frame: what could survive all of them?
entries.teaches: Collage of threats around one human face; the face stays the largest and brightest element.
entries.roblox_use: Hero face with 2-3 hazards or biomes around it showing the game's variety, not 10 things.

entries.title: Escape 100 Cops, Win $500,000
entries.composition: Panicked face in a red car at left, a wall of police cars racing to a vanishing point
entries.colours: Red car vs blue/red police lights, grey road
entries.text: 100 COPS top right, white with black outline
entries.hook: Escape from impossible numbers
entries.teaches: Repetition of one shape toward a vanishing point sells quantity with no counting.
entries.roblox_use: Hero vs a receding crowd of enemies (or rivals) leading the eye to a horizon.

entries.title: Last To Leave Mansion, Keeps It
entries.composition: Calm host in suit bottom-left, grand mansion with many people in the windows, litter on the lawn
entries.colours: Blue sky, white mansion, red outfits, green lawn
entries.hook: Ownership prize plus a crowd who are all still competing
entries.teaches: Prize object big, competitors small and numerous; the host's calm contrasts with the chaos.
entries.roblox_use: The prize (house, pet, vehicle) in full view with tiny competing avatars dotted around it.

entries.title: 50 YouTube Legends Fight For $1,000,000
entries.composition: Host smile at left, a long row of gold busts receding right
entries.colours: Black, gold, red blazer
entries.hook: Famous people turned into trophies: who are they?
entries.teaches: Gold plus repetition equals value; one colour family keeps a busy row legible.
entries.roblox_use: A row of identical trophies/characters in one metallic colour leading into depth.

entries.title: 7 Days Stranded in The Arctic
entries.composition: Overhead shot, a tiny figure spread out on a small iceberg in dark blue water
entries.colours: Cyan/blue sea vs white ice and a single red suit
entries.hook: Isolation: smallest possible subject, biggest possible danger
entries.teaches: Extreme scale contrast; one warm red figure on a cold blue field is unmissable.
entries.roblox_use: Tiny character in a huge environment with one complementary-colour accent; works for obby/adventure.

entries.title: $1 vs $1,000,000,000 Futuristic Tech!
entries.composition: Large smiling face left, a hovering white futuristic car with thrusters, neon track
entries.colours: White car, neon red and blue, dark background
entries.hook: $1 vs $1B futuristic tech: look how far it goes
entries.teaches: Face large, gadget second, background dark so both pop; the brand shirt is part of a sponsor deal.
entries.roblox_use: Hero face plus one futuristic item on a dark background with neon rim light; do not use real brand logos.

entries.title: Survive 30 Days Trapped In The Sky, Win $250,000
entries.composition: High-angle shot of a figure sitting on a tilted platform with bed items, floating above clouds with a helicopter
entries.colours: Sky blue, red tracksuit, yellow-black hazard stripes
entries.hook: A person trapped in the sky: how is that possible?
entries.teaches: A top-down view makes height felt without a number; the red outfit isolates the subject.
entries.roblox_use: High-angle shot of the player on a tiny platform far above the world; great for obby/tower.

entries.title: World's Strongest Man Vs Robot
entries.composition: Robot left, referee centre, strong man right, symmetrical with the host small in the middle
entries.colours: Grey metal, green grass, black/white stripes
entries.hook: Man vs machine: who wins?
entries.teaches: Symmetry with an outsider in the middle reads as a match announcement.
entries.roblox_use: Two opposing characters at the edges, a neutral third in the middle; strong as a boss-vs-player card.

entries.title: World's Fastest Car Vs Cheetah!
entries.composition: Cheetah snarling large at left, host in an open-wheel car at right
entries.colours: Gold cheetah, red car, blue sky
entries.hook: Fastest car against the fastest animal
entries.teaches: A close-up animal face is a built-in stake; the driver is smaller but looks steady.
entries.roblox_use: Roblox: giant creature close-up at the edge with the player character small and calm beside it.

entries.title: I Spent 100 Hours Inside The Pyramids!
entries.composition: High-angle shocked face on the left, golden sarcophagus with a skeleton and two tiny people
entries.colours: Gold, brown, teal shadows, jewel red
entries.hook: Hidden treasure in an ancient place
entries.teaches: Scale from tiny people next to a huge object; warm gold draws attention.
entries.roblox_use: Hero in awe beside a vast treasure/boss; use a small figure for scale.

entries.title: Beat Ronaldo, Win $1,000,000
entries.composition: Two faces head to head with a ball between them, stadium behind
entries.colours: Portugal red/green vs light blue, floodlights
entries.hook: Beating a world-class star
entries.teaches: Two matched faces at identical size say 'equal match'; the ball is the center of attention.
entries.roblox_use: Rival heads touching with the shared prize in the middle.

entries.title: 50 YouTubers Fight For $1,000,000
entries.composition: Host left in plain white tee, glowing cyan cube packed with blue-tracksuit people at right
entries.colours: Black background, electric cyan, white tee
entries.hook: Fifty people in a box: who will be left?
entries.teaches: Dark background plus a neon container isolates a busy crowd into one shape.
entries.roblox_use: A crowd of avatars packed in one glowing container shape on a dark background.

entries.title: World’s Deadliest Obstacle Course!
entries.composition: Small runner on a few planks over a valley, wide scenic background
entries.colours: Blue sky, green forest, orange planks
entries.hook: Deadly obstacle course
entries.teaches: Tiny figure plus void; planks are the simplest threat read.
entries.roblox_use: A tiny avatar on a precarious path over a huge drop; show the obby fear in one glance.

entries.title: 7 Days Stranded On An Island
entries.composition: Wet torn shirt, face centre, storm, waves and a campfire behind
entries.colours: Desaturated blue-grey storm vs warm skin
entries.hook: A week of survival on an island
entries.teaches: Weather and torn clothes tell the story; a counter adds time.
entries.roblox_use: Visibly damaged character in dramatic weather; a day counter if the game has survival days.

entries.title: $10,000 Every Day You Survive In A Grocery Store
entries.composition: Dirty face and a hand reaching toward camera, empty shelves, trolley
entries.colours: Yellow, red, grey, white tee with logo
entries.hook: Reach for the last item: scarcity
entries.teaches: A reaching hand toward the lens is a gaze/touch cue that pulls the viewer in.
entries.roblox_use: Hand or weapon reaching towards the camera with the reward behind; implied motion.

entries.title: $1 vs $100,000,000 Car!
entries.composition: Big smiling face centre, junk car left on grass, gold hypercar right over water
entries.colours: Rust red vs yellow, green vs blue water
entries.hook: Poor car vs ultra car: price contrast
entries.teaches: A pair of opposite objects either side of one face; the numbers do the explaining.
entries.roblox_use: Starter item vs endgame item either side of the character, with 1 and 1M style numbers.

entries.title: $1 vs $500,000 Plane Ticket!
entries.composition: Two-panel split: cheap economy seat vs gold first-class, the same pose
entries.colours: Blue/grey seat vs warm gold
entries.hook: Cheap vs luxury plane ticket
entries.teaches: Same pose in both halves; only the surroundings differ.
entries.roblox_use: Same character in a starter hub vs a luxury hub; two panels.

entries.title: Real Life Spider-Man Vs Skyscraper
entries.composition: Host crawling in a spider suit on glass over a city, wide-angle from below the glass
entries.colours: Red suit, city blues, glass reflections
entries.hook: Real-life Spider-Man
entries.teaches: Costume gives a ready-made hero; the vertigo angle sells danger.
entries.roblox_use: Character in a recognisable-genre costume (your own design) in a vertigo camera angle.

entries.title: I Built Willy Wonka's Chocolate Factory!
entries.composition: Host in purple coat and yellow top hat, factory castle with a big sign behind
entries.colours: Purple, yellow, pastel sky
entries.hook: Recreating a well-known fictional place
entries.teaches: Costume plus a landmark building equals instant genre; strong two-colour palette. Licensed IP: not to be copied.
entries.roblox_use: Own mascot in a signature costume at the entrance to your game's landmark; no existing IP.

entries.title: $456,000 Squid Game In Real Life!
entries.composition: Face half covered by a cracked mask, a red jumpsuit, dark teal metal, mask on the left
entries.colours: Red against cold teal
entries.hook: Recreating a famous drama with real stakes
entries.teaches: Half-hidden face is a curiosity gap; red on teal is maximum contrast.
entries.roblox_use: Character with a partly covered face or object hiding half the frame; works for horror/mystery games.

entries.title: Last To Leave Circle Wins $500,000
entries.composition: Aerial crowd packed in a red circle on bright green grass, host selfie at left
entries.colours: Red ring, bright green, team-colour shirts
entries.hook: Staying inside the circle for hours
entries.teaches: A thick graphic outline (the circle) turns a crowd into one object; green and red are complements.
entries.roblox_use: A thick coloured ring or highlight around the players or the prize.

entries.title: Would You Sit In Snakes For $10,000?
entries.composition: Extreme close face with snakes round the neck and a hand holding a snake head up
entries.colours: Red, green, yellow snakes, bathroom tile
entries.hook: Would you sit in snakes for money?
entries.teaches: Face and threat both fill the frame; nothing else competes. Snakes are fine in the real world; do not post gore in Roblox.
entries.roblox_use: Large face with one big friendly-spooky creature; keep it non-graphic for all ages.

entries.title: I Ate $100,000 Golden Ice Cream
entries.composition: Host eating a golden sundae from a spoon, surprised eyes
entries.colours: Purple background, gold dessert
entries.hook: Absurd luxury food
entries.teaches: A single golden item against a flat purple background pops instantly.
entries.roblox_use: One exaggerated reward item and a reacting character on a flat saturated backdrop.

entries.title: Press This Button To Win $100,000!
entries.composition: One huge red button on a white background, no face
entries.colours: Red on pure white
entries.hook: What happens if you press it?
entries.teaches: Pure object plus pure contrast: one question and nothing else.
entries.roblox_use: Icon-style: one giant button or item on a flat colour; ideal for the 512 icon.

entries.title: I Filled My Brother’s House With Slime & Bought Him A New One
entries.composition: Smiling host with a hose, a living room flooded with green slime
entries.colours: Slime green dominates, brown furniture
entries.hook: Filling a house with slime
entries.teaches: One dominant colour covers the scene, the face is the sole warm spot.
entries.roblox_use: Hero with a hose or tool spraying one bright colour across the scene.

entries.title: I Adopted EVERY Dog In A Dog Shelter
entries.composition: Host holding puppies surrounded by dozens of dog faces
entries.colours: Warm gold fur, blue hoodie
entries.hook: Adopting every dog in a shelter
entries.teaches: Many faces looking at the viewer (and one kissing him) is charm; the blue hoodie contrasts with the golds.
entries.roblox_use: Hero hugging a crowd of pets/creatures; collectible fantasy for pet games.

entries.title: I Built The World's Largest Lego Tower
entries.composition: Big face left, huge rainbow LEGO tower with a helicopter for scale
entries.colours: Rainbow primary colours, blue sky
entries.text: LEGO in a yellow badge, outlined
entries.hook: World's largest tower of a toy
entries.teaches: Foreground face versus very distant tower gives forced perspective; helicopter proves size.
entries.roblox_use: A close-up character and a giant landmark behind with a small vehicle for scale.

entries.title: Anything You Can Fit In The Circle I’ll Pay For
entries.composition: Host pointing with an arrow at a red circle on a carpet
entries.colours: Red circle and arrow on grey carpet
entries.hook: Anything that fits in this circle: how much?
entries.teaches: A drawn circle is a game rule in a single mark; a red arrow tells the eye where to look.
entries.roblox_use: Draw the rule on the image: a ring or arrow showing the game objective.

entries.title: Going Through The Same Drive Thru 1,000 Times
entries.composition: Host in a car surrounded by fast-food bags, a server at the window
entries.colours: Yellow bags, red steering wheel, warm
entries.hook: Doing the same thing 1,000 times
entries.teaches: Clutter that accumulates is a progress bar; the counter gives a number.
entries.roblox_use: Pile of collected items and a counter showing your progress or rank.

entries.title: Surviving 24 Hours On A Deserted Island
entries.composition: Host lying on a beach, a crab beside his face, sea and island
entries.colours: Turquoise sea, sandy tan
entries.hook: 24 hours alone on an island
entries.teaches: Face on the ground at a low angle puts the viewer at eye level with the subject.
entries.roblox_use: Low camera angle on a tired avatar near a small creature or prop.

entries.title: I Opened The World's First FREE Store
entries.composition: Host pointing down at a text block, shelves full of electronics with FREE stickers
entries.colours: Product-box colours, white/black text, red stickers
entries.text: EVERYTHING FREE in huge white letters, black stroke
entries.hook: A free store: take anything
entries.teaches: Early-style: text is the hook here; clear and big but 2 words. Avoid 'free' claims in Roblox (rule: no free Robux).
entries.roblox_use: Do not copy: for Roblox use a visual reward instead of a 'FREE' claim.

entries.title: Homeless Man Buys A Lamborghini
entries.composition: Yellow supercar with a man holding cash, showroom logo behind
entries.colours: Yellow vs dark showroom
entries.hook: A homeless man buying a supercar
entries.teaches: Hero object in the brightest colour, person with money = story.
entries.roblox_use: One flashy vehicle in one saturated colour against a dark background.

entries.title: Standing Still For 24 Hours Straight - Statue Challenge
entries.composition: Grey statue figure in a colourful city crowd
entries.colours: Greyscale figure vs vibrant street
entries.hook: Standing still for 24 hours
entries.teaches: Colour isolation: the greyscale subject separates from the colourful busy background (von Restorff effect).
entries.roblox_use: Make the hero the one element in a different colour or lighting from a busy backdrop.

entries.title: Pass All 12 Grades, Win $10,000
entries.composition: Smiling host and a puzzled child at school desks
entries.colours: Blue and red shirts, classroom neutrals
entries.text: 6 YEAR OLD top right, white with black outline
entries.hook: Passing all grades against a young kid
entries.teaches: The text names the twist; two faces looking in different directions = tension.
entries.roblox_use: Two characters with contrasting size/age and 2 words naming the twist.

entries.title: Make This Video The Most Liked Video On Youtube
entries.composition: Plain brown egg on a white background
entries.colours: Beige on white
entries.hook: Make this the most liked video
entries.teaches: Radical minimalism: an object that breaks the thumbnail style of the feed (pattern interrupt).
entries.roblox_use: Icon concept: a single iconic object with plenty of white space.

entries.title: I Put Millions Of Pennies In My Friends Backyard
entries.composition: Host with a wide grin buried to the shoulders in pennies, hands up
entries.colours: Copper pennies fill the frame
entries.hook: Millions of pennies in a backyard
entries.teaches: The material fills the whole frame, repeated texture signals quantity.
entries.roblox_use: Hero partly buried in a huge pile of the game's currency.

entries.title: I Put 100 Million Orbeez In My Friend's Backyard
entries.composition: Host chest-deep in multicolour Orbeez, looking sideways
entries.colours: Rainbow beads, black hoodie
entries.hook: 100 million Orbeez
entries.teaches: Colour confetti around one dark figure; looking away is a gaze cue to look at the beads.
entries.roblox_use: Hero in a sea of colourful collectible items; gaze to the side to direct the eye.

entries.title: Things That SHOULDN'T Be Sold On Amazon
entries.composition: Host with an alarmed face aiming a rifle-like object, an Amazon box at the right
entries.colours: Red hoodie, tan gun, brown box
entries.hook: Things that should not be sold on Amazon
entries.teaches: The shock face and a weird object, but a gun is not allowed in Roblox thumbnails.
entries.roblox_use: Roblox: replace with a non-weapon silly object; never aim anything at the viewer.

entries.title: Can A Glowing 1000 Degree Sword Slice A Car In Half?
entries.composition: Strongman holding a glowing red-hot sword going through a car window
entries.colours: Glowing orange-red on white car, green trees
entries.hook: Can a 1000-degree sword cut a car?
entries.teaches: A glow is the only colour accent on a neutral frame, so it reads at once.
entries.roblox_use: One glowing object as the only saturated element; glow effect in the script.

entries.title: I Donated $50,000 To Ninja - Fortnite
entries.composition: Gamer in headset, shocked, with a donation text overlay
entries.colours: Teal and white text, team shirt
entries.text: A full sentence of overlay text
entries.hook: Donating money to a famous streamer
entries.teaches: Cluttered text: an example of what not to do; also uses a real person's face.
entries.roblox_use: Do not copy: text too long and uses a real person.

entries.title: Do Water Repellent Shoes Actually Work?
entries.composition: Person standing on water, arms out, a wide scene
entries.colours: Blue water, green lawn, red shorts
entries.hook: Do water-repellent shoes work?
entries.teaches: Impossible-looking action with an easily read cause; wide shot.
entries.roblox_use: Character doing an impossible thing in a clear environment.

entries.title: Rocket League In Real Life!
entries.composition: A giant ball and cars in a smash, ball dominates the left
entries.colours: White ball, blue and red cars, sparks
entries.text: ROCKET LEAGUE IRL top, white with outline
entries.hook: A video game made real
entries.teaches: Game-IRL concept with 3 words of text; the ball is the hero object.
entries.roblox_use: Referencing another game by name is risky for Roblox; use the idea (giant ball + cars) only.

entries.title: Moving 10 Pounds Using ONLY Sound
entries.composition: Wall of 100 speakers above a dumbbell
entries.colours: Black speakers, yellow dumbbell
entries.hook: Move 10 lb with sound
entries.teaches: A wall of repeated objects equals scale; the one yellow object gives a target.
entries.roblox_use: A giant wall of repeated objects plus a number.

entries.title: Breaking Glass Using Only Megaphones
entries.composition: Line of megaphones aimed at a glass, boy with ear defenders in the lower left
entries.colours: Blue megaphones, grassy field
entries.hook: Breaking glass with megaphones
entries.teaches: Repetition in perspective guides the eye to the glass; the reaction is in the corner.
entries.roblox_use: Rows of devices all aiming at one target.

entries.title: I Bought One Snickers Bar From Every Walmart
entries.composition: Excited, mouth open, hugging an armful of chocolate bars at a store
entries.colours: Red text, grey store, brown wrappers
entries.text: WORLD RECORD in red with white outline
entries.hook: Buying one bar from every store
entries.teaches: An early-era thumbnail: busy and a lot of text, effective only because the claim is big.
entries.roblox_use: Do not copy: use one icon, not the claim text.

entries.title: Saying Logan Paul 100,000 Times
entries.composition: A tight face, bored expression in front of posters
entries.colours: Pastel, indoor
entries.hook: Saying a name 100,000 times
entries.teaches: Baseline: the face alone with no hook; shows how far later thumbnails evolved.
entries.roblox_use: Boring portrait: the thing to avoid.

entries.title: Worst Minecraft Saw Trap Ever???
entries.composition: Raw gameplay frame with recording watermark and a zombie mob
entries.colours: Grey stone, green mob
entries.hook: Worst saw trap ever
entries.teaches: An unedited in-game screenshot with watermark; the thing the vault says hurts CTR.
entries.roblox_use: Raw game screenshots with HUD or watermark: do not ship.

entries.title: Harry Potter Mod In Minecraft! EPIC MUST SEE MOD!!!
entries.composition: Raw landscape frame with a sword in the corner and hotbar visible
entries.colours: Green, white, blue sky
entries.hook: Harry Potter mod
entries.teaches: Early Minecraft example; shows HUD and UI clutter inside the frame.
entries.roblox_use: Cut the HUD and hotbar, always.

entries.title: Hi Me In 10 Years
entries.composition: Plain selfie of a younger face in a bedroom, neutral
entries.colours: Warm bedroom browns
entries.hook: A note to a future self
entries.teaches: Authentic, plain and emotional thumbnails can work when the premise is the hook.
entries.roblox_use: Rarely: only for a premise-led story game.

entries.title: I Granted 100 Kids Their Biggest Wish!
entries.composition: Host, a smiling child and a famous actor in a step-and-repeat photo wall
entries.colours: Blue background, formal clothes
entries.hook: Granting wishes for children
entries.teaches: Warm faces looking at camera build trust; celebrity and event logo are the hook.
entries.roblox_use: Do not copy: real celebrities and third-party logos are out for Roblox.

entries.title: I Advertised Pewdiepie At The Super Bowl
entries.composition: Screen capture of a stadium crowd holding banners, a LIVE badge
entries.colours: Grey crowd, red LIVE label
entries.hook: Ad at a huge event
entries.teaches: A fake-live badge borrows UI trust; not allowed for Roblox as a fake UI.
entries.roblox_use: Do not copy: no fake UI badges.
